scripts.build: npm run build:declarations && cross-env BUILD_PLATFORM=web vite build
scripts.build:web: npm run build:declarations && cross-env BUILD_PLATFORM=web vite build
scripts.build:all: npm run build:web && npm run build:mobile
scripts.test-storybook:ci: concurrently -k -s first -n "SB,TEST" -c "magenta,blue" "npm run storybook" "wait-on tcp:6009 && npm run test-storybook"
scripts.test:all: npm run test && npm run test:stories
